# Created 2026-07-27 (adopted from the SHADE/BROCK fleet pattern). Fleet-standard 5-col schema.
# disposition vocabulary: acted | noted | info-only | killed | dup | provenance
#   acted     = changed a score, a rail, a routing decision, or forced a correction
#   noted     = absorbed as mechanism/precedent; no score moved
#   info-only = read, adjacent, another agent owns the action
#   killed    = tested and NOT carried (record WHY — a cheap kill is a deliverable)
# DISCIPLINE: log at READ time, not at closeout. An unlogged consume is indistinguishable from a never-seen.
